definitions.explanation: Describes a person or situation where things turn out favorably by chance. A common everyday expression using 運 (luck) + が + 良い (good).

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{運|うん}が{良|い}い。
{運|うん}が{良|よ}ければ、⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取れる：02376_toreru⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: If we're lucky, we might be able to get tickets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{遅|おく}れた→乗り遅れる：04621_noriokureru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧{運|うん}が{良|よ}かった。
examples.english: I missed the train, but the next one came right away — I was lucky.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in the conditional form {運|うん}が{良|よ}ければ (if lucky) and the past form {運|うん}が{良|よ}かった (was lucky). The opposite is ⟦{運|うん}→運：02143_un⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (unlucky).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運|うん}が{良|い}いこと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (fortunately; luckily)
- {運|うん}が{良|よ}ければ (if one is lucky)
- {運|うん}が{良|い}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a lucky person)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ラッキー→ラッキー：11254_rakkii⟧: lucky — casual loanword, often used as an exclamation
- ⟦{幸運|こううん}→幸運：02725_kouun⟧な: fortunate — more formal
- ついて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to be on a lucky streak — colloquial
